authority_rule: Read the preserved Stage 2 map together with these amendments. These named changes supersede only the affected preparation/progression fields; all other objectives, timing, attendance and independent domain gates remain. An amended future outline is not a detailed workout or a granted competency.

amendments.reason: A first-visit release, global all-clear and retrieval for 15 athletes cannot fit the 180-second target budget alongside the position task.
amendments.current_decision: P1 is one unloaded chest-start reach/return. P2 progressively adds actual floor pickup, chest hold, short carry, floor set-down and permission without release. First actual release and full retrieval are counted in E1. Do not credit P2 with a throw or retrieval pass.

amendments.reason: OR-02's exact low forward jump profile requires independently known basic bilateral flight. Grounded instruction gives no flight pass, and the former OR-06/15/19 chain only retained that jump. The curriculum needs an explicit first-flight acquisition route.
amendments.current_decision: Use one of two independently eligible learning branches. Retained known primary task: hold the actual qualified OR-02 forward landing variation/geometry OR the actual familiar independently eligible grounded task while considering a manageable hinge variant or hold decision. Jump ability is not a strength prerequisite. First-flight instructional branch: teach a small bilateral takeoff and controlled landing from an actually controlled grounded preparation; hold the actual unloaded hinge variant, setup and recent dose, or explicitly teach the small unloaded set when history is unknown. If first-flight readiness is absent, use the separately eligible grounded/slow position task. First two-dumbbell handling requires actual basic unloaded hinge control before loading and counted pickup/grip observation, but not a prior perfect loaded repetition. No new primary movement accompanies the first loaded variant. No calendar-based jump, rebound or simultaneous hinge progression.

first_flight_contract.authoring_requirements: Search existing basic-jump and first-landing instruction records and identity boundaries. Map or fully propose the exact teaching variant, prescribe all three ages and D/L dose/rest/effort, count preparation and main attempts, verify coaching and landing space, and independently review the day. Do not relabel the prior-qualified forward-jump profile as first-flight instruction. If no eligible physical branch fits, retain grounded instruction and record the gap.

amendments.retained_hinge_rule: Use actual OR-02/03/04/05 or direct equivalent unloaded hinge setup and completed dose/response. A bodyweight-to-dumbbell change requires its own implement/grip/variant instruction; it is not an inherited approved load increase.
amendments.next_evidence_rule: Record actual flight versus nonflight task, takeoff/landing assistance or cue needs, dose and response separately. Emerging first-flight work is not a same-day automatic pass to the forward jump or main JUMP branch.

amendments.reason: The first complete paused exit needs counted teaching and a protected diagonal exit area. It cannot inherit either a terminal-stop exercise identity or the old three-lane preparation return model, and it must not be assumed to fit P2.
amendments.current_decision: Keep the full instructional preparation base and exactly two90-second targets: P1 actual retained supported stance/bilateral finish, or independently eligible quiet standing; P2 one retained straight walking stop, or its distinct stationary alternative. Teach the first early-announced45-degree2m ordinary walking exit in counted E1 after a complete balanced2-second stop. No assessed exit occurs in P2. E1 requires actual control of the corresponding approach/stop, without a prior perfect whole exit. First jogging stop and first exit are separate learning routes.

delivery_contract.stationary_alternatives: Own inspected personal preparation bay; transfer within opening setup if needed; no central staging/return. Direct view from Coach1 pad required; no concurrent main action. Actual fit remains unverified.

amendments.progression_contract: Retain actual approach, gradual braking, support, depth and smaller recent stop opportunities/stance holds. Choose and record first exit direction before release; counts are direction-specific prefixes, with no repayment attempts or automatic both-side pass. Today uses one unloaded hinge set even after actual OR06 DB work, explicitly a deliberate unloading; preserve actual1/2/3-repetition ceilings. Do not shorten the pause, speed up the approach/exit, remove stance support or add strength load today.
amendments.next_evidence_rule: OR11 may change the pause only after actual repeatability in the relevant direction at retained approach/angle; OR13 retains separate movement and cue gates. Planned attendance, terminal stopping, P2 side clearance and supported stance do not grant an exit or reactive-cut competency.

amendments.reason: The retained short15m preparation task cannot be described as a complete35m progressive run. Count full-route orientation and the first modest effort change inside the main block; preserve actual recent strength/history while introducing that effort decision.
amendments.current_decision: Full instructional preparation base plus40s P1 basic rhythm and140s P2 independently selected retained short start/runout, walking or stationary task. No4/10 effort or full-route running is assigned in P2. One counted E0 whole-corridor walk/eligible standing orientation precedes E1. The first2→4/4 run requires actual repeatable prior2→3/3 long running and current runoff fit, without a prior perfect4/10 attempt. Retained/first easy running, short acceleration, walking and stationary alternatives remain separate. A directly repeatable actual same-route2→4/4 record may instead support retention without reconstructing an older easy-run record. Both paths require suitable current response and runoff fit; record first increase versus hold, with no repeatability inferred from one emerging attempt.

modest_entry_paths.retention: actual repeatable same-route2→4/4, no reconstructed older easy record
modest_entry_paths.both: current response and runoff fit independently required; record chosen basis

amendments.strength_contract: Five familiar roles, one set each. Explicit1/2/3 knee and hip caps and low supporting-dose level retain actual recent reductions. Familiar two-DB hip is D-only and requires the most recent actual compatible loaded record, full10s familiar handling and90s recovery. One first-DB lesson is not automatic familiarity. Actual OR07 unloading is not silently reversed. Five suitable stations/ten actual fitting DBs/two-coach direct views are conditional; unavailable resources mean deliberately unload before pickup or defer.
amendments.next_evidence_rule: OR12 retains actual route/output while changing responsibility for recovery/return under coach release; OR16 observes the same actual task. Walking, short starts, cue values and attendance do not supply unobserved long-run or maximal-velocity competency.

amendments.reason: The full familiar throw and global retrieval cannot be assumed to fit a140 s preparation target. Give that rehearsal its complete counted main clock while preserving total actual opportunities before adding choice.
amendments.current_decision: Keep the full base plus40 s P1 unloaded arm-path rehearsal and140 s P2 no-release floor handling. First main opportunity E0 rehearses the known task on one early individual cue with complete shutdown/retrieval. E1 uses only remaining opportunities for the selected THROW/HOLD prefix or an independently eligible known/no-release route. Total main reference3/2/2/1 (standard D/L,compressed D/L) includes E0; cap1/2 preserves actual smaller totals. No uncounted rehearsal or repayment throw.
amendments.strength_contract: Five familiar roles, one set each, ordered push/pull/knee/hip/brace with6 min standard or4 min compressed each. Retain actual recent OR08/direct setup/load/range and smaller knee/hip/support packets. Familiar DB hip is D-only, requires independent10 s handling, five fitting stations/ten suitable DBs and20 s between-wave reset with90 s recovery. Newer unloading governs over older loaded history; no automatic loading/count restoration or first loaded setup with new cue learning.
amendments.next_evidence_rule: OR13 retains an independently passed movement/cue branch; OR17 observes the actual retained rule with reduced prompting. Early-release REACT-T permission can remain while HOLD is emerging, if that rule and throw/retrieval are separately passed. No reactive-cut or landing result is inferred.

amendments.reason: The short P2 walk is not a whole purposeful start/runoff rehearsal. First knee loading needs directly observed handling and a longer instruction allocation than a familiar five-athlete station. Actual more recent lower running intent and unloaded/smaller strength records must govern.
amendments.current_decision: Retain full instructional base including knee/hip checks, P1 one3s personal-bay start hold with2s settle, P2 one declared10m/15m ordinary walking orientation or independently suitable stationary task. Place the whole already-qualified running rehearsal in counted E0 within total main opportunities; E1 uses only the remaining scheduled prefix. Retain actual technical20m6075%D/5060%L or explicit5060%low-intent carryover in D, actual easy15mD, or independently eligible walking/standing. Make one justified knee resistance decision with recent count/range/stance/3-1-1 retained; do not simultaneously increase running.
amendments.next_evidence_rule: After individual source/programming/numeric review, audit full written Week2 OR06–10 including mixed attendance, actual smaller counts/intent, first-vs-retained handling, deliberate unload/reintroduction and OR11–15 carryover. OR14 changes prompting/group-flow responsibility while retaining actual demand; OR18 compares actual conditions without graduation loading.

amendments.reason: Carry OR-06's actual first-flight or retained landing branch forward without overwriting it with assumed forward-jump competence.
amendments.current_decision: Consolidate the actual qualified OR-02/OR-06 landing or grounded teaching task at its recorded geometry and dose. Continue instruction where flight remains emerging. A justified hinge change is separate and cannot accompany a new landing task or output increase. Only actual independent repeatability can support a later variant change; no additional flight/main-entry permission follows from the date.

amendments.reason: Verification must concern the athlete's actual retained branch, including first-flight instruction or grounded work when appropriate.
amendments.current_decision: Verify only the actual eligible retained OR-06/OR-15 landing task or the independently passed stable-throw route. An emerging or grounded landing record stays instructional. Do not rename first-flight/grounded work a completed forward-jump assessment, substitute throw results for landing results, or award entry from planned attendance.

unchanged_carryover_requirements.OR-07: A controlled stop and supported stance do not establish the announced exit. Teach/observe that exit independently at retained approach and support; no reactive cut.
unchanged_carryover_requirements.OR-08: Increase running intent only after the actual easy route is repeatable and the existing runoff/return still fits the proposed demand. Short acceleration remains its distinct route/objective.
unchanged_carryover_requirements.OR-09: Add go/no-go only to the actual repeatable stable throw and known release, retaining implement, stance, direction, intent and retrieval. Its proposed preparation release needs its own counted feasible clock; do not inherit OR-05 P2 as a throw.
unchanged_carryover_requirements.OR-10: Retain actual start/runoff and independently map/teach front-held load pickup/set-down before a goblet progression; bodyweight squat alone is not implement-handling evidence.
